metadata.title: CAMELS-PL: hydro-meteorological time series and landscape attributes for 869 catchments in Poland
metadata.description:
Description:

CAMELS-PL provides a comprehensive collection of hydro-meteorological time series and catchment attributes for 869 streamflow gauges across Poland. The hydrological time series (discharge and water level) span from 1 January 1951 to 31 October 2025; the meteorological time series derived from E-OBS v33.0e span from 1 January 1951 to 31 October 2025; the supplementary meteorological time series derived from G2DC-PL+ span from 1 January 1951 to 31 December 2019; and the benchmark model simulations (LSTM and HBV) cover the full modelled period from 1 January 1951 to 31 October 2025. All time series are in daily resolution. The static catchment attributes include information about topography (derived from the Copernicus GLO-30 DEM and a national 10 m DEM), climate, hydrology, soils (derived from SoilGrids250m and the Polish SWAT soil database, which also provides soil hydraulic properties), and land cover derived from both the European CORINE Land Cover 2018 dataset and the national BDOT10k topographic database. Catchment boundaries and gauging station locations are provided as shapefiles and GeoPackage files and were obtained from IMGW-PIB. Additionally, the dataset includes discharge simulations from a regionally trained Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network, which uses static soil attributes from the Polish SWAT soil database, and a locally calibrated conceptual HBV model, providing benchmark data for future hydrological modelling studies in Poland. Potential evapotranspiration is provided using both the Hargreaves and the Penman equations; the HBV model was calibrated with Hargreaves.
Information about the code and methods for generating CAMELS-PL can be found here: https://github.com/bigapple233-cmyk/Hy2DL/tree/CAMELS-PL

Disclaimer:

  • Discharge, water level time series, and catchment boundary data included in CAMELS-PL were obtained from the Institute of Meteorology and Water Management — National Research Institute (IMGW-PIB). For terms of use, please refer to: https://danepubliczne.imgw.pl

  • Catchment-aggregated meteorological time series derived from E-OBS are excluded from CC BY 4.0 and are subject to the ECA&D/E-OBS Data Policy.

Changelog

  • v2.1.0
    • Corrected an error in the calculation of Hargreaves potential evapotranspiration (PET) and updated the corresponding daily PET time series.
    • Re-ran the HBV modelling workflow using the corrected Hargreaves PET inputs.
    • Updated the HBV simulated discharge time series, calibrated parameter sets, and benchmark performance metrics.
    • This release supersedes the Hargreaves PET and HBV modelling outputs provided in version 2.0.0. Users working with these variables should use version 2.1.0.
  • v2.0.0
    • Extended release of CAMELS-PL, expanding the dataset from 354 to 869 catchments across Poland.
    • Includes daily hydrological time series for 869 catchments across Poland (1 January 1951 – 31 October 2025).
    • Includes daily meteorological time series derived from E-OBS v33.0e for 869 catchments across Poland (1 January 1951 – 31 October 2025).
    • Includes catchment attributes covering topography (Copernicus GLO-30 DEM and national 10 m DEM), climate, hydrology, soils (SoilGrids250m and Polish SWAT soil database), CORINE land cover, and BDOT10k national land cover.
    • Includes simulated discharge time series and benchmark results from a regional LSTM model (5 ensemble members) and a locally calibrated HBV model (5 calibration seeds using the DREAM algorithm).
    • Includes potential evapotranspiration estimated using the Hargreaves and Penman equations.
    • Includes HBV model parameter sets and LSTM model training epoch files for all ensemble members.
    • Includes supplementary meteorological time series from the G2DC-PL+ gridded dataset for 869 catchments across Poland (1 January 1951 – 31 December 2019).
